name: deslop-writing
description: Remove AI writing patterns, preserve meaning, and refine your voice in English and Brazilian Portuguese.

interface.longDescription: A writing and editing assistant for people working on emails, articles, posts, and other prose in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Revise drafts to remove repetitive phrasing, inflated language, and mechanical structure while preserving facts, quotations, uncertainty, and the author's intent. Includes human-ai for English editing and humanizar for Brazilian Portuguese writing and editing. Works with the current model without external services or account setup. It does not determine authorship or guarantee AI detector results.
defaultPrompt: Edit this email to sound natural while preserving every fact and commitment.
Remove repetitive AI phrasing from this draft and keep my voice.
Revise this Brazilian Portuguese text without changing its meaning.
